answer: At 27 units per epoch, sustaining 273 aliases for 57 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. The fee is charged through a vault debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the quill totals, and the anchor anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
